candidates.title: Welcome board
candidates.composition: A left text column and a warm sun illustration; two outlined session cards sit on a rounded sage table.
candidates.typography: Left-aligned 56px display greeting over a 14px kicker and 16px body; asymmetric against a large sun illustration.
candidates.interaction: Open a session from an introductory board and return to the greeting.

candidates.title: Session agenda
candidates.composition: A tinted masthead with a clock illustration over a dotted timeline of rounded time rows.
candidates.typography: 48px masthead in a tinted band with a clock illustration; 20px times on a timeline beside 16px session names.
candidates.interaction: Inspect an agenda entry from a structured schedule and return to the list.
